text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove has been chosen by the URA as Umamusume of the Year, and her noble conduct during the ceremony is a testament to her worthiness to represent her generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober also takes notice of this and becomes convinced that chasing after Air Groove will help her build a new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, I feel a strange sensation gripping my chest… but I'm not sure why.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mejiro Bright fully immerses herself in intense training for the spring Tenno Sho. Mejiro Ryan is concerned by her fervency and has a chat with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Through their conversation, however, Mejiro Ryan comes to understand how strong Mejiro Bright's desire to live up to the Mejiro legacy is, and she decides to cheer her on.
